endorsements.quote: Post-deployment monitoring is essential for algorithms in clinical practice to minimize the risk of patient or operator harm and maximize benefit, such as significant time savings, decreased cognitive load, and/or improved patient care.
Algorithm deployment begins with a multiphase limited rollout and development of a post-deployment monitoring plan.
Individuals reviewing output are encouraged to submit a ServiceNow (ServiceNow Inc) ticket when errors are found.

unlisted_practices: Involve appropriate stakeholders, such as scanner technologists and medical physicists who may modify DICOM tags, in post-deployment monitoring to ensure images continue to be routed correctly.
Solicit end-user feedback annually to ensure algorithms continue to meet clinical needs and to guide enhancements.

screen.reason: Empirical case report/study detailing Mayo Clinic's real deployment of 17 radiology AI algorithms and measuring the implementation and utility of post-deployment monitoring practices (automated alerts, drift monitoring, failure modes, user feedback).

primary.practice: post-deployment drift and failure mode monitoring dashboards
